import numpy as np
labels = [int(t.get_text()) for t in ax.get_xticklabels()]
colors = ['#808080' if l < 14 else '#ff7f0e' for l in labels]
for bar, c in zip(ax.patches, colors):
    bar.set_facecolor(c)
    bar.set_edgecolor('black')
vals = [b.get_height() for b in ax.patches]
mask_low = np.array(labels) < 14
mask_high = np.array(labels) >= 14
mean_low = np.mean([v for v, m in zip(vals, mask_low) if m])
mean_high = np.mean([v for v, m in zip(vals, mask_high) if m])
ax.axhline(mean_low, color='blue', linestyle='--', label=f'1-13주 평균: {mean_low:.1f}')
ax.axhline(mean_high, color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'14-26주 평균: {mean_high:.1f}')
ax.legend()
